speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Friday, at the word Nurse, it went out from under him. A note that belongs to a man. Nobody laughed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two acts of her. She sleeps through some of it. I will not cut her. I will not write her a line lower.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Phillips said the mornings have not begun. They have not. I do not see the boy today.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The letter. That one I can finish.
